t0.metric_population: live parents before decision at t=0; retrieval metrics are category-macro averages and live_parent_count is the raw pooled count

t1.metric_population: live parents before decision at t=1; retrieval metrics are category-macro averages and live_parent_count is the raw pooled count

t2.metric_population: live parents before decision at t=2; retrieval metrics are category-macro averages and live_parent_count is the raw pooled count

absorbed_stop_occupancy.interpretation_limitation: must not be interpreted as new STOP hazard
absorbed_stop_occupancy.population: all trajectories, including trajectories stopped earlier
absorbed_stop_occupancy.reduction_axes: mean over B separately by timestep

context_pairwise_cosine.interpretation_limitation: context similarity alone does not imply equal edits
context_pairwise_cosine.population: live parents before the decision at each reported timestep
context_pairwise_cosine.reduction_axes: mean over B_live only; reported separately by timestep

delta_q_pairwise_cosine.definition: Deltaq_t,k=qhat_t+1,k-q_t; pairwise cosine is defined only when both effect norms are > 1e-08
delta_q_pairwise_cosine.interpretation_limitation: functional similarity does not identify its cause; inactive pairs are excluded rather than assigned cosine zero
delta_q_pairwise_cosine.population: live same-parent counterfactuals at each timestep
delta_q_pairwise_cosine.reduction_axes: mean over B_live only; KxK preserved

delta_z_pairwise_cosine.definition: cos(vec(DeltaZ_t,i), vec(DeltaZ_t,j)) only when both effects have L2 norm > 1e-08
delta_z_pairwise_cosine.interpretation_limitation: token-effect similarity is not retrieval utility; null means no valid active-pair observations
delta_z_pairwise_cosine.population: live parents before the decision at each reported timestep
delta_z_pairwise_cosine.reduction_axes: flatten N,d; mean over B_live; KxK preserved

dominant_tokenwise_grounding_mass_share.reduction_axes: max over K per token, sum over N, then mean over B

functional_effect_activity.interpretation_limitation: numerical inactivity is not semantic edit failure and has no causal meaning
functional_effect_activity.population: live same-parent counterfactuals at each timestep
functional_effect_activity.reduction_axes: candidate fraction over B_live,K; dead-parent fraction over B_live

functional_effective_rank.definition: exp(entropy(normalized singular values of the KxD effect matrix)); diagnostic convention r_eff=0 when singular-value mass <= 1e-8
functional_effective_rank.interpretation_limitation: uncentered numerical rank is not semantic factor count; zero rank denotes only a numerically zero effect matrix
functional_effective_rank.population: live parents before the decision at each timestep
functional_effective_rank.reduction_axes: SVD over K,D; mean scalar rank over B_live

late_step_effect_retention.interpretation_limitation: different live populations make this descriptive, not causal
late_step_effect_retention.reduction_axes: norm over D, mean over B_live,K

new_stop_hazard.definition: new STOP selections at t / live parents before decision t
new_stop_hazard.interpretation_limitation: policy behavior, not semantic factor inactivity
new_stop_hazard.population: live parents before the decision at each timestep
new_stop_hazard.reduction_axes: sum over B separately by timestep

pairwise_intent_cosine.definition: cos(I_i, I_j) for every ordered candidate pair i,j
pairwise_intent_cosine.interpretation_limitation: representational similarity is not semantic correctness
pairwise_intent_cosine.reduction_axes: mean over B only; KxK matrix preserved

retrieval_control_ratios.definition: control Mean Recall / FULL Mean Recall
retrieval_control_ratios.interpretation_limitation: relative performance alone does not establish causality
retrieval_control_ratios.population: the same FashionIQ validation queries and protocol gallery

same_parent_counterfactual_retrieval.definition: retrieval of every qhat_t+1,k constructed from the same q_t/Z_t
same_parent_counterfactual_retrieval.interpretation_limitation: oracle uses targets offline and is never a model action
same_parent_counterfactual_retrieval.population: live parents before the decision at each timestep
same_parent_counterfactual_retrieval.reduction_axes: retrieval per K plus offline best-candidate oracle and mean query

selected_path_target_similarity_improvem.interpretation_limitation: offline target-relative observation; no target enters forward
selected_path_target_similarity_improvem.population: live parents whose actual selected action was non-STOP
selected_path_target_similarity_improvem.reduction_axes: cosine over D; distribution summarized per timestep

single_and_repeat_controls.definition: SINGLE_k executes k once from Z0 then stops; REPEAT_k executes k through the real updated recurrent state for Tmax steps
single_and_repeat_controls.interpretation_limitation: control superiority is an observation, not a causal mechanism

support_probability_overlap.interpretation_limitation: overlap does not establish semantic ownership
support_probability_overlap.population: all validation queries; static supports computed once
support_probability_overlap.reduction_axes: sum over N, then mean over B; KxK preserved

definitions_and_limits.grounding_over_diffuse: observes support fraction >= configured audit threshold
definitions_and_limits.grounding_over_sparse: observes support fraction <= configured audit threshold
definitions_and_limits.high_dead_delta_q_fraction_t0: observes many numerically inactive candidate effects at t0; this does not establish semantic edit failure or a causal mechanism
definitions_and_limits.high_dead_delta_q_fraction_t1: observes many numerically inactive candidate effects at t1; this does not establish semantic edit failure or a causal mechanism
definitions_and_limits.high_dead_delta_q_fraction_t2: observes many numerically inactive candidate effects at t2; this does not establish semantic edit failure or a causal mechanism
definitions_and_limits.high_delta_q_similarity: observes high mean off-diagonal same-parent Deltaq cosine; potential functional candidate collapse, without causal localization
definitions_and_limits.high_delta_q_similarity_t0: observes high same-parent Deltaq cosine among active pairs at t0; null means no live parents or no valid active pair
definitions_and_limits.high_delta_q_similarity_t1: observes high same-parent Deltaq cosine among active pairs at t1; null means no live parents or no valid active pair
definitions_and_limits.high_delta_q_similarity_t2: observes high same-parent Deltaq cosine among active pairs at t2; null means no live parents or no valid active pair
definitions_and_limits.high_stop_t0_occupancy: observes STOP occupancy at t0 >= threshold; does not explain why STOP was chosen
definitions_and_limits.high_support_similarity: observes high support-map cosine; does not establish semantic grounding failure
definitions_and_limits.low_functional_effective_rank: observes low uncentered Deltaq effect rank; not semantic factor count
definitions_and_limits.low_functional_effective_rank_t0: observes low numerical Deltaq effective rank at t0; rank is not semantic factor count and all-zero effects have diagnostic rank zero
definitions_and_limits.low_functional_effective_rank_t1: observes low numerical Deltaq effective rank at t1; rank is not semantic factor count and all-zero effects have diagnostic rank zero
definitions_and_limits.low_functional_effective_rank_t2: observes low numerical Deltaq effective rank at t2; rank is not semantic factor count and all-zero effects have diagnostic rank zero
definitions_and_limits.never_stop: observes zero new STOP decisions; not a claim about required edit count
definitions_and_limits.reference_dominates: observes REFERENCE_ONLY exceeds FULL by margin
definitions_and_limits.repeat_beats_full: observes best REPEAT Mean Recall exceeds FULL by margin
definitions_and_limits.selected_policy_underperforms_candidate_: observes offline t0 oracle exceeds FULL by margin; oracle never enters policy
definitions_and_limits.single_beats_full: observes best SINGLE Mean Recall exceeds FULL by margin
definitions_and_limits.single_candidate_monopoly: observes maximum conditional edit-selection share >= threshold
